      "when": "Tuesdays 9:30am - 11:00am",

      "source_name": "Halton Region"

      "name": "EarlyON Child and Family Centres, Acton & Georgetown locations",

Notes on what backs each pick:


The Kids & Me program at the library runs Thursdays 10:30 am - 12:00 pm as a drop-in program where families can play with toys, enjoy a storytime, and do fun activities.
 
Participants can arrive any time during the stated program time.



Halton Region also lists a Kids & Me session at St. Andrew's United Church, Georgetown, Tuesdays from 9:30 to 11 a.m.
 
Kids & Me is a free weekly 1.5-hour parenting and early learning drop-in program for families with babies or children up to 6 years of age, where you and your child can make new friends and enjoy playing with other children.
 
These drop-in programs follow the school calendar and are closed during holidays and breaks.
 
Registration is not required.



Links2Care offers FREE programs, activities, and resources for children from birth to their 6th birthday and their parents or caregivers, in Halton Hills
, with locations including 
Acton EarlyON Centre, Acton Community Hub, and Georgetown EarlyON Centre
. Their page didn't post specific daily times in what I could read, so I'd suggest calling ahead for the current schedule.
